title: Milliohm impedance measurement of commercial lithium-ion cells: data, analysis and hardware
description: Impedance spectra of two commercial cylindrical lithium-ion cells measured with a compact current-excitation analogue front-end and with a Stanford Research EC301 potentiostat at 72 frequencies between 20 mHz and 10 kHz; temperature series of two 18650 cells between -10 and 50 degrees Celsius; the analysis scripts for the error metrics, the linear Kramers-Kronig test and the figures added to the paper at revision; and the circuit files. Supporting the article in Energy Storage.
